title: Customer activation framework for beta rollouts and release cadence
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description:
Goal: Deliver a repeatable, low-friction customer activation framework that coordinates beta rollouts (including lighthouse accounts), synchronized release notes, and cross-team GTM activities so that early customers reach time-to-value within 72 hours and we gather high-signal qualitative and quantitative feedback.

Context: Prior beta runs have had inconsistent onboarding handoffs, staggered release notes, and insufficient instrumentation to tie feature telemetry to success criteria. This ticket consolidates a single play-style framework that PMs, Eng, Design, CS, and Sales can follow for the next set of beta waves (10-15 accounts).

Scope:
- In-scope: launch checklist, templated release notes cadence, lighthouse engagement scripts, instrumentation for onboarding funnels and key evals, 1:many onboarding materials, weekly feedback synth cadence.
- Out-of-scope: core runtime feature delivery (ENG tickets own model-serving fixes) and long-term automated billing integrations beyond pilot credits management.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Three lighthouse accounts have completed onboarding and provided structured feedback within two weeks of rollout.
A2: Release notes and feature summary are published to the docs site and emailed to pilot participants at the same time the feature is available to them.
A3: Onboarding funnel baseline metrics (activation rate, time-to-first-successful-inference, error rate) are captured in the console dashboard and accessible to PM/CS within 48 hours.
A4: A repeatable 7-step kickoff checklist and contact handoff is documented and approved by Eng, Design, CS, and Sales.
A5: Feedback triage workflow (labeling, owner assignment, SLA for response) is operational and integrated with the feedback tracker.

communication_plan: Weekly launch sync (Mon 10:00 PST) with PM/ENG/DES/CS/Sales. Use #beta-lighthouse Slack channel for async updates. All customer-facing communications must land in the docs repo (docs.redwood.ai/beta) and have a release-notes tag. Draft GTM assets stored in Google Drive > Beta Launch > PM-9421.
release_notes_plan: Single-source-of-truth in the docs repo: master release note draft created by PM 48 hours before deployment. Engineering adds component-level caveats and known issues. Legal/Trust reviews required only for data handling notes (none expected). Final notes go to: docs.redwood.ai/beta/release-2026-03-28 and are emailed to pilot participants at T+0. A short changelog digest will be posted to the Console 'What's New' panel and included in the weekly customer newsletter.
lighthouse_engagement_plan: Tiered approach: (1) Identify and classify accounts by expected usage and integration type. (2) Run a kickoff call (PM + CS + Eng rep) covering goals, SLO expectations, and data collection consent. (3) Provide a 2-week enablement sprint with clear milestones: test traffic, integration validation, latency baseline, and an evaluation checklist. (4) Weekly check-ins for first 14 days, then bi-weekly. Capture success stories and blockers for case study follow-up.
feedback_loop_and_metrics: Primary metrics: activation_rate, time_to_first_successful_inference, average_token_latency_95th, error_rate_per_1000_requests, qualitative_satisfaction_score (CS survey). Feedback flow: CS collects notes -> Tag in feedback tracker (label: beta-lighthouse) -> PM triages -> ENG assigns bug fixes or backlog items. Set SLA: initial PM triage within 48 hours, engineering acknowledgement within 5 business days for critical regressions.
success_criteria: 80% of lighthouse seats achieve successful inference within 72 hours of starting integration.
Net qualitative satisfaction >= 4/5 in CS survey after 14 days.
Two actionable product improvements surfaced and prioritized in the next quarterly roadmap.
Release notes reach pilot participants on time and result in <= 3 support escalations related to miscommunication.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Instrumentation gaps lead to blind spots. Mitigation: ENG provides a small verification harness and PM runs verification on sample accounts before rollout.
Risk: Lighthouse customers expect production SLAs. Mitigation: Clear contractual scope in pilot agreements and sales briefings; ensure Sales/Legal sign-off.
Risk: Cross-team misalignment on release timing. Mitigation: Hard freeze for release notes 48 hours before and a daily readiness check in the Launch Sync.

final_notes: This ticket should act as a template for subsequent beta rollouts. After wave 1 conclude, we will extract a condensed 'Beta Launch Checklist' that can live in the Console onboarding modal for self-serve pilots.
